set system host-name Spoke-CE1.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment used to identify the equipment in the network.

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.1.1.1/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

set interfaces lo0 unit 1 family inet ad.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces lo0 unit 1 family inet ad.command: set interfaces lo0 unit 1 family inet address 11.11.11.11/32
set interfaces lo0 unit 1 family inet ad.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses and subnet masks for loop back interfaces.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

set protocols bgp group external-peers t.command: set protocols bgp group external-peers type external
set protocols bgp group external-peers t.explanation: Configure the type of BGP group to be external.

parameters.name: type
parameters.explanation: Type of BGP group, e.g. external.

set protocols bgp group external-peers p.command: set protocols bgp group external-peers peer-as 100
set protocols bgp group external-peers p.explanation: Configure the BGP group's equivalent AS.

set protocols bgp group external-peers n.command: set protocols bgp group external-peers neighbor 10.1.1.2
set protocols bgp group external-peers n.explanation: Configure the neighbors of the BGP team.

set protocols bgp group external-peers f.command: set protocols bgp group external-peers family inet unicast
set protocols bgp group external-peers f.explanation: Configure BGP protocol settings for a specific group and address family

set protocols bgp group external-peers e.command: set protocols bgp group external-peers export export-loopback
set protocols bgp group external-peers e.explanation: Configure the BGP group export policy.

set policy-options policy-statement expo.template: set policy-options policy-statement [parameter1] term [parameter2] from route-filter [parameter3] [parameter4]
set policy-options policy-statement expo.command: set policy-options policy-statement export-loopback term 1 from route-filter 11.11.11.11/32 exact
set policy-options policy-statement expo.explanation: Configure the matching conditions for the policy statement.

parameters.name: route-filter
parameters.explanation: Route filter, which matches a specific route.

parameters.name: match-type
parameters.explanation: Match type, e.g. exact indicates an exact match.

set policy-options policy-statement expo.command: set policy-options policy-statement export-loopback term 1 then accept
set policy-options policy-statement expo.explanation: Configure the action for the policy statement.
